# Excel to Dashboards — Automated KPI Reports & Business Intelligence Generator

> Excel to Dashboards (excel.dattasable.com) is a free, 100% client-side web application built by Datta Sable that transforms raw CSV and spreadsheet datasets into boardroom-ready multi-sheet Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) workbooks featuring native formulas (SUMIFS, AVERAGEIFS), interactive KPI scorecards, dynamic charts, and executive presentation layouts.

## Core Capabilities
- In-Browser Processing: 100% private execution inside the client sandbox with zero cloud data storage.
- Native Excel Formulas: Real SUMIFS, AVERAGEIFS, and calculation formulas embedded directly into exported .xlsx files.
- Automated Schema Inference: Automatically infers dates, revenue amounts, quantities, categories, and geographical regions.
- Multi-Tab Workbooks: Produces Executive Overview, Pivot Table Analysis, Source Records, and Regional/Product Breakdowns.
- 32 Enterprise Industry Models: Pre-configured benchmarks for SaaS, Retail, Healthcare, Finance, Manufacturing, Logistics, and more.
